problems.problem: Contact shadow under the bottle base is very faint against the bright veined marble, so the heaviest element reads slightly light-anchored.
problems.evidence: Base at y=960 on the marble plane shows only a whisper of occlusion while neighbouring ice cubes carry stronger, wetter contact shadows.
problems.repair: Deepen and slightly widen the elliptical contact shadow at the base and add a faint cool cast shadow to match the cubes' grounding.

problems.problem: The bottom-right ice cube sits close to the price line's visual lane, mildly crowding the lower margin.
problems.evidence: Cube cluster at approx (640-740, 910-1010) versus price text baseline zone y=1015-1026 on the left; the corner feels busy relative to the quiet brief.
problems.repair: Shift the right cube cluster up 40-60 px or reduce it to a single cube to keep the footer lane clean.

problems.problem: Bottle reads pasted onto the counter: contact occlusion is too weak for the warm ambient diner light and thePerspective plane.
problems.evidence: Base at y=895 meets the laminate with only a thin dark line; no cast shadow follows the counter's receding perspective, unlike the booth and trim which all model light.
problems.repair: Add a soft directional cast shadow along the counter plane and strengthen the contact core so the bottle shares the room's light.

problems.problem: Footer price line loses readability where it crosses the bright chrome trim and dark booth blur.
problems.evidence: White 15px text at y=1015-1026 sits over the high-contrast chrome edge and burgundy blur at lower left.
problems.repair: Move the price line into the uniform dark booth band or add a subtle dark scrim behind it.

problems.problem: Unspecified blurred white cylinder at mid-left acts as a distracting prop the brief did not authorize.
problems.evidence: Vertical white blur near (75-120, 520-620) competes with the subtitle zone and implies tableware the scene policy excluded.
problems.repair: Paint out the object or blur it into the wall tone so the left lane carries only copy.

problems.problem: Grounding is under-resolved for a gallery still-life: the contact shadow is faint and the bottle's frontal packshot light never meets the stone's soft gradient.
problems.evidence: Base at y=945 on the limestone floor shows a thin occlusion line only; the arched recess and floor gradients imply a broad top-front light that the bottle does not cast or receive.
problems.repair: Add a soft elongated cast shadow consistent with the recess light and a faint floor occlusion gradient around the base.

problems.problem: Title and subtitle hug the upper-left corner while the product sits center-left, leaving the right two-thirds of the wall empty and unbalancing the hierarchy.
problems.evidence: Title bbox (48,83)-(514,156) and product bbox x 185-365 both occupy the left lane; the right wall carries nothing at any scale.
problems.repair: Shift copy block right or scale the title into the right negative space so type and product form a diagonal read.

reason: Motion is the only study with zero defects: the flat graphic satin field is an intentional non-physical presentation, so no floor is required, and the bottle's retained source RGB, white-baked neck transmission and crisp label sit cleanly against the vermilion textile with strong contrast, correct hierarchy (headline, subhead, footer) and on-brand red dominance. Ice, diner and sculpture all keep faithful product and legible authorized copy, but each shows a grounding or readability flaw (weak contact/cast shadow against modeled scenes, footer contrast loss, stray prop, unbalanced negative space) that blocks acceptance under the stated thresholds.
